legend: Each line: TYPE name "text" {property refs} H|V fill/hug WxH. Nested instances not expanded.
container:
COMPONENT type=general container V 1400x145
  SLOT header V fill/hug 1336x81
card:
COMPONENT primary color=true, status=Default, type=elevated V 400x351
  SLOT header slot V fill/hug
    INSTANCE card header
  SLOT content Slot V fill/fill 368x199
  SLOT CTA slot {visible:has CTA} H fill/hug
textFieldVariants: state=input/has value=textField; state=hover|focused|error|disabled with has value=true; state=enabled|hover|focused|error|disabled with has value=false (label on); label in only with has value=true
textAreaVariants: label on: enable|hover|focused|error|disable x has value true|false; label in: has value=true only
autocompleteVariants: label on: enable|hover|filled|focus|error|disable x has value true|false; label in: has value=true only
radio:
COMPONENT status=default, Size=lg H 113x48
  INSTANCE radiobox-blank 24x24
  TEXT Label Text "Label Text" (no text property: override the layer)
listSection:
COMPONENT type=menu lists V 912x260
  FRAME header {visible:has title} > TEXT Label "Section title"
  SLOT list container slot V fill/hug (3 sample list items)
  FRAME Divider {visible:divider}
modal:
COMPONENT type=alert, rounded corner=true V 600x353
  FRAME Container H
    INSTANCE Alert Icon {visible:has icon}
    TEXT Modal content "Alert title text"
    INSTANCE Close Icon {visible:close}
  SLOT content slot V fill/hug
  SLOT CTA Section {visible:Show CTA Section} V fill/hug
